How SiteVue works

## See What's Actually Happening on Your Floor

1. 01 · Inside the walls


### See the Whole Floor at Once


From the assembly cells to the forklift lane, SiteVue sees the whole floor at once, from overhead, at the station and on a hard hat. Installs in days, with no software integration required.

2. 02 · The operation


### Every Station, Measured


SiteVue times every cycle at every station, straight from video. Utilization shows who waits on whom, and the slowest station is the bottleneck that sets the pace of the whole cell.

3. 03 · The product


### Catch a Missed Step as It Happens


SiteVue follows each unit through its SOP and flags one that leaves a step short while it is still at the station, long before final inspection.

### Optimize Traffic Flow, Reduce Risk

Overhead cameras track every person and machine moving through the floor, mapping foot traffic and equipment paths in real time to flag high-traffic zones and near-miss crossings. Dwell time and crossing frequency are logged automatically, giving safety and operations teams the data to redesign layout, staging, and traffic flow before a near-miss becomes an incident.

### Safety Zone Alert System

In high traffic areas where forklifts or robotic equipment is used, cameras with AI can provide live audible and visual alerts to prevent accidents.

### Robotic Drift Detection

Mounted cameras track the weld head against its programmed path through every weld position. Positional drift is flagged the moment it's detected, triggering a maintenance alert before it affects weld quality.

### Coach With Real Line Data

Cameras measure who is actually working and who is waiting, so incentives are based on real, verifiable data. Reviews stop hinging on whatever a supervisor happened to see most recently, and the people carrying the floor get recognized before they start looking elsewhere.

## Unique Form-Factors Designed to Fit Your Operation

Custom Hardware

01Hard Hat

First-person POV mounted directly on the operator's hard hat. Captures exactly what each team member sees, ideal for assembly verification, welding inspection, and quality control checks.

02Uniform

Clipped to the operator's uniform for hands-free, wearable capture. Easy to deploy across large teams with no equipment modifications or plant infrastructure changes required.

03Safety Glasses

Built into standard-issue safety eyewear operators already wear. Delivers the same first-person capture as the hard hat camera without adding gear, for sites where a hard hat mount isn't practical.

04Station

Fixed to walls or equipment for station-level visibility. Ideal for monitoring throughput and adherence at specific points on the line: assembly cells, inspection stations, or packaging.
